mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which positively impacts related industries and the broader economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods following a sustained increase in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over three months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it indicates strong consumer demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) both increase by more than 0.5% within a month, it signals inflationary pressure combined with monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals strong economic growth and labor market improvement, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows > 2% QoQ and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.
